method: Only REDIRECT existing [S#] slots (m = count of regex \[S\d+\] in the baseline answer); no slot addition/removal; one slot hits at most one truth (min(m, truth) / truth); empty truth -> 0. oracle_store_hit is the theoretical all-truth bound. oracle_store_hit_achievable only counts store truths whose mapped runtime chunk is present in this case's context (context-reachable; the actual M6a bound). oracle_recall_evi_achievable intersects T_rt with Ctx. Offline truth use only; never enters product.
